---
title: "Geographic correlation of transitory mortality shocks"
format: html
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(geosphere)
library(segmented)
```

```{r load-fits}
fits <- readRDS(here("results", "adjusted_model_fits.rds"))
ratio_unpooled_list <- fits$ratio_unpooled_list

# drop US aggregate, AK, HI
drop_regions <- c("US", "USA", "United States", "AK", "HI", "Alaska", "Hawaii")
keep <- setdiff(names(ratio_unpooled_list), drop_regions)
ratio_unpooled_list <- ratio_unpooled_list[keep]
```

```{r extract-transient}
# For each unpooled fit (n=1), the latent state has 2 components:
#   row 1 = persistent (random walk w/ drift)
#   row 2 = transient (B=0, mean-zero, variance q_t)
# The transient state is the part of the year-to-year shock that is NOT
# explained by the known sampling variance.
transient_mat <- t(sapply(ratio_unpooled_list, function(f) f$states[2, ]))
rownames(transient_mat) <- names(ratio_unpooled_list)

# pairwise Pearson correlation across states
corr_matrix <- cor(t(transient_mat))
```

```{r centroids-distances}
# centroids of lower 48 from map_data (lowercase full names)
us <- map_data("state")
centroids <- us %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  group_modify(~ as.data.frame(centroid(cbind(.x$long, .x$lat)))) %>%
  ungroup()

# map state abbreviations (rownames of corr_matrix) to lowercase full names
abb_to_name <- setNames(tolower(state.name), state.abb)
state_lookup <- tibble(
  abb  = rownames(corr_matrix),
  name = abb_to_name[rownames(corr_matrix)]
) %>% filter(!is.na(name) & name %in% centroids$region)

centroids <- centroids %>% filter(region %in% state_lookup$name)
centroids <- centroids[match(state_lookup$name, centroids$region), ]

# pairwise great-circle distances in miles
dist_m <- distm(centroids[, c("lon", "lat")], fun = distVincentySphere)
dist_miles <- dist_m / 1609.344
rownames(dist_miles) <- colnames(dist_miles) <- state_lookup$abb

# subset corr to matched states (in same order)
corr_matrix <- corr_matrix[state_lookup$abb, state_lookup$abb]
```

```{r long-format}
upper_to_long <- function(M, value_name) {
  M[lower.tri(M, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
  as.data.frame(M) %>%
    rownames_to_column("state1") %>%
    pivot_longer(-state1, names_to = "state2", values_to = value_name,
                 values_drop_na = TRUE)
}

distance_long <- upper_to_long(dist_miles, "distance")
corr_long     <- upper_to_long(corr_matrix, "shock_correlation")

combined_long <- inner_join(distance_long, corr_long,
                            by = c("state1", "state2"))
```

```{r plot}
n_years <- ncol(transient_mat)
null_band <- 2 / sqrt(n_years)

# Segmented regression: estimate a breakpoint, initialized near 1500 miles
lin_fit <- lm(shock_correlation ~ distance, data = combined_long)
seg_fit <- segmented(lin_fit, seg.Z = ~distance, psi = 1500)
breakpoint <- as.numeric(seg_fit$psi[, "Est."])

pred_grid <- tibble(distance = seq(min(combined_long$distance),
                                   max(combined_long$distance),
                                   length.out = 400))
pred_grid$shock_correlation <- predict(seg_fit, newdata = pred_grid)

p <- ggplot(combined_long, aes(x = distance, y = shock_correlation)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = breakpoint, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  geom_line(data = pred_grid, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance between state centroids (miles)",
    y = "Correlation in transitory mortality shocks",
    title = "Geographic correlation of transitory shocks in lower 48 states"
  )

print(p)

ggsave(here("results", "fig-geo-correlation.pdf"),
       plot = p, width = 10, height = 10)
```
